_comment: PINNED UPSTREAM SOURCES. This file is the root of the determinism claim:
an import is reproducible because the bytes it reads are fixed here, not
because a URL happened to serve the same thing twice.
`sha256` is null until the file has actually been fetched and pinned
(`python3 src/fetch_source.py --pin`). While it is null the importer
REFUSES to run. Once set, a fetch that does not match aborts rather than
Note the dates: WotC reissued the French PDF seven months after the
English one, at the same version number. The upstream moves without
announcing it. That is precisely why the pin is by hash and not by URL.
`attribution` below is TRANSCRIBED FROM SECONDARY SOURCES and is marked
unverified. It must be replaced with the wording read from the PDF's own
legal page before anything is published. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
